result.brief: 论文提出直接动作排序（DAR）并系统归因 GUI 世界模型预测与评估器对动作选择的贡献，指出预测后继画面在强直接评估器下无额外排序信号，主张以决策价值而非预测保真度评价世界模型。
result.reason: Studies GUI world-model lookahead for action selection and argues predicted successors add no ranking signal beyond a direct evaluator; agent decision value, not video/multimodal representation learning.
